candidate_workaround: Pass concrete directories to ripgrep and constrain filenames with -g filters.
failure_signature: Windows rejects a literal wildcard embedded in a path argument.
recurrence_guard: Use rg -g for wildcard selection on Windows rather than wildcard path arguments.
rollback: Treat the failed search as no result and rerun against real directories with filters.
title: Windows ripgrep glob-filter guard
trigger_preconditions: versioned files must be searched on Windows
